name: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Procession of Daoist Deities: Leaf 1
summary: Leaf 1 portrays one of the three supreme deities in the Daoist religion. Dressed in a garment and hat similar to that of an earthly emperor, this heavenly being holds a tablet in a posture also reminiscent of a mortal ruler.
